title: Classify each term before choosing display groups
summary: Internal types and displayed resume labels are distinct; examples illustrate classification rather than mandatory resume content.
body: Every skill term receives an internal classification before compatible terms are combined into a small number of readable resume lines. A displayed group need not have the same name as the internal type. Broad disciplines and methods must not be presented as concrete technologies. The examples below preserve the agreement; include terms only when useful for the JD. Do not invent a model name from a generic reference to LLMs. The agreement gives examples, not an exhaustive closed taxonomy or fixed displayed labels.
